products.title: Allentown Comedy Festival 2027 Comedian Submissions
products.body_html:
Allentown Comedy Festival Returns for Year Two!

Last year, we set out to put Allentown on the comedy map.

Now we’re building something even bigger.

The Allentown Comedy Festival returns February 19-21, 2027, for three days of stand-up, showcases, open mics, special events, and more throughout Allentown.

Our inaugural festival welcomed hundreds of guests, 60+ comedian submissions, and performers representing nearly 10 states. Rooms filled across the city with local favorites, regional standouts, and nationally recognized talent. Comedians traveled to Allentown from across the East Coast, audiences discovered new performers and new spaces, and before the weekend was even over, people were already asking about Year Two.

And the response this year has already exceeded our expectations.

More than 180 comedians have submitted for ACF ’27, representing 14+ states and counting.

We’re just getting started.

Comedian Submissions Are OPEN!

We’re looking for comedians ready to be part of the next chapter of the Allentown Comedy Festival. Whether you’re from the Lehigh Valley or traveling in from across the country, we want to see what you’ve got. Throw your name in the mix for ACF ’27.

CURRENT SUBMISSION RATE - $30

$30 submissions are available through November 30, 2026.

The final submission rate will increase to $40 beginning December 1.

All comedian submissions close December 31, 2026.

How to Submit

1. Pay the submission fee.
Current submission fee: $30 through November 30.

2. Complete the official ACF ’27 submission form.
Tell us about yourself, your comedy, where you’re coming from, and anything else we should know.

SUBMIT TO ACF ’27

3. Show us what you’ve got.
The submission form will ask for a link to a recent performance clip. YouTube, Vimeo, Instagram, or another publicly accessible video link is fine. Please make sure your video can be viewed without requesting access.

Both payment and a completed submission form are required for your submission to be considered.

Submitting does not guarantee placement in the festival. Selected comedians will be contacted with additional details after the submission period.

February 19-21, 2027

More comedians.
More venues.
More shows.
More opportunities.
More ways to experience comedy in Allentown.

We’re building on everything that made Year One special while creating an even stronger experience for the comedians who perform, the guests who fill the rooms, and the city that hosts it.

Welcome back to the Allentown Comedy Festival™.

Year Two is going to be something special.

products.title: "Spilled Ink. | Open Mic Poetry Reading
products.body_html:
"Spilled Ink." | MONTHLY Open Mic Poetry Reading!

Join us on the final Wednesday of each month for "Spilled Ink.", our vibrant series celebrating the beauty and power of spoken word. Each event may include a featured poet and other exciting surprises, making every gathering unique! Whether you’re a seasoned performer or sharing your voice for the first time, "Spilled Ink." is your platform to shine. We’re dedicated to creating a welcoming space where every voice matters.

Tickets are just $10 for non-performers—support the arts! *or add on the "on canvas" experience for just an additional $20, (see details belo!). Enjoy free parking nearby, courtesy of Truist Bank, and a complimentary beverage on us!

Hosted by the amazing poet Lisbeth (& friends), the night promises perfect vibes and memorable moments. As our community of poets and spoken word artists continues to grow, we invite you to be part of this creative journey.

Grab your friends, bring your words, and join us for a night where "All are welcome to the well." Secure your spot now and be part of an unforgettable celebration of poetry and spoken word. We can't wait to see you there!

COOL AND UNIQUELY INKWELL. NEW ADD ON DETAILS BELOW!

Experience Spilled Ink in a whole new way. As poetry fills the room, add on the ‘on canvas’ experience for just an additional $20: paint your feelings, your visions, or simply the moment. No instructor, just you, the canvas, and emotion in color. Let’s make art happen while art happens.

products.title: Music & Memories | A Karaoke Experience at "the well."
"The Creative Collective." | A Mixed Media Open Mic
products.body_html:
Join us for "The Creative Collective," a monthly event held on the third Thursday of each month at Inkwell. This exciting mixed media open mic event is dedicated to creative expression, providing a platform for artists of all kinds to share their talents in a supportive and vibrant atmosphere.

Hosted by the dynamic Sharin, the event offers an engaging platform for showcasing talents and connecting with fellow creatives. products.title: "inkwell. Run Club." | 5k Sunday
products.body_html:
Join us every Sunday of the month for the "inkwell. Run Club. 5K Sunday"! Kicking off at 9 AM, we invite runners, joggers, and walkers of all levels to participate in a fun and encouraging 3.1-mile run. This event is designed to foster community spirit and promote an active lifestyle, so whether you’re a seasoned runner or just starting out, all are welcome! 

After the run, stick around for “Well Water.”, inkwell.'s premium coffee services, where you can enjoy a refreshing beverage while mingling with fellow participants. We’ll also have light tunes playing to create a relaxed and inviting atmosphere. This is a fantastic opportunity to connect with other exercise enthusiasts and make healthier choices together. Best of all, it’s a free inkwell. community event!  Don’t miss out on this chance to get active and build community with us—let’s make the inkwell. Run Club 5K Sunday a memorable event!

products.title: "Make Me Laugh Mondays" | Comedy Open Mic at inkwell.
products.body_html:
Get Ready to Giggle: "Make Me Laugh Mondays." at inkwell.!

Welcome to the funniest night in Allentown: "Make Me Laugh Mondays." at inkwell.! Located at 1125 Hamilton St, our comedy open mic is the place where laughter takes center stage every other Monday night.

Doors and sign-ups open at 6:30 PM, and the mic heats up at 7 PM. Whether you're a comedy connoisseur or just need a good chuckle to start your week, this is the spot for you.

What started as a humble gathering in 2024 has blossomed into a must-see event. People are flocking from near and far, all seeking the sweet sound of laughter — and perhaps a little fame!

Tickets are just $10 for non-performers. That’s less than a fancy cup of coffee, and way more entertaining! Come support local comedians as they deliver their best punchlines.

And here's the kicker: every month, our "fan favorite" comedian earns a spot at a future ticketed event, complete with cash prizes. Who knew your laughs could lead to someone else’s paycheck?

Join us at inkwell., where every other Monday promises to tickle your funny bone and maybe even make you a part of comedy history. Finally, a reason to look forward to Mondays! Grab your tickets now!!

products.title: FRIDAY THE 13TH: LIVE at inkwell.
products.body_html:
Five acts. One stage. One unforgettable night.

Friday the 13th is about to get loud.

On November 13, inkwell. brings together five bands for an electrifying night of alternative rock, metal, grunge, punk, and everything in between.

Featuring:

ALEIRA - Haunting melodies, crushing riffs, and dark atmospheres collide as this Wilkes-Barre gothic/alternative metal band blends emotional intensity with modern heaviness.

RESOLVER - A woman-founded hard rock/grunge band bringing raw energy, unapologetic attitude, and powerful original music from New York and Pennsylvania.

Skin Mag - Lancaster's five-piece metal outfit delivers a fierce combination of emotional vocals, guitar harmonies, and heavy breakdowns that refuses to fit neatly into one genre.

MFGPAINK - Experimental post-punk from Reading, PA. A little weird, a little unpredictable, with skate-punk roots and a sound all their own.

Opossum - A Philadelphia project pulling from punk, metal, and dark Western rock for a distinctive, genre-bending sound.

Five different voices. Five different approaches. One shared stage.

Experience live music the way it's meant to be experienced: up close, surrounded by sound, and part of something happening right in front of you.

Friday, November 13, 2026 | Doors: 6:30 PM | Music: 7 PM | Advance: $15 | Door: $20 | All ages welcome.

inkwell. | 1125 Hamilton Street, Allentown, PA

Limited tickets available.

Welcome to "the well."

*ALL SALES ARE FINAL

products.title: inkwell.'s 2nd Annual "FIT FRIENDSGIVING"

products.title: Albert Davis & Friends LIVE at inkwell.
products.body_html:
Philly’s bringing the funny. Allentown, grab your seats.

products.title: LOUDER. | All-Female-Fronted Rock Showcase
products.body_html:
Louder. | Women Who Rock.

Four female-fronted bands. One stage. Zero apologies.

Saturday, November 28, we're turning up the volume at inkwell. with Leadpetal, Hello, Operator?, Almost Serious, and Cyan Xavier for an unforgettable night celebrating women in music, independent artistry, and community.

LOUDER. is more than a rock show. It's a celebration of creativity without boundaries, artists unapologetically taking up space, and the power of live music to bring people together.

Expect loud guitars, raw talent, electric performances, and the intimate, high-energy atmosphere that makes every experience at the well. something special.

AND THERE'S MORE!

We're taking the art beyond the stage with a female tattoo artist offering small linework tattoos on-site! That's right, you might leave with more than memories. Designs, pricing, and availability will be announced soon. *Tattoos are priced separately from admission.

EVENT DETAILS

Saturday, November 28, 2026 | Doors: 6:30 PM | Music: 7 PM

Tickets: $12 advance | $15 at the door

Location: inkwell. | 1125 Hamilton St., Allentown, PA

All ages: Guests under 17 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.

PROUDLY SOBER. PROUDLY INDEPENDENT.

inkwell. is an alcohol-free creative space. We encourage guests to support our concessions throughout the evening. Every purchase helps sustain independent arts programming and keeps experiences like LOUDER. happening.

Come for the music. Stay for the community. Leave inspired.

"All are welcome to the well."

Art. Happens. Here.
